# GCP Instances — Pricing Comparison Tool

> A free tool to compare Google Cloud Platform instance types, specifications, and pricing across all regions and commitment tiers. Maintained by DoiT International.

## What This Tool Does

- Compare all Compute Engine VM instance types (N1, N2, N2D, E2, C2, C2D, C3, C3D, M1, M2, M3, A2, A3, G2, and more)
- Compare Cloud SQL instance types for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server
- Compare Memorystore instance types for Redis and Valkey
- Compare AlloyDB for PostgreSQL instance types
- Filter by region, vCPUs, memory, machine family
- View on-demand, spot/preemptible, and committed use discount (1yr / 3yr) pricing
- Support for 12 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD, CAD, DKK, NOK, SEK, CHF, ZAR, ILS)

## Pricing Data (JSON, updated daily from Google Cloud Billing Catalog API)

- **Compute Engine**: https://gcpinstances.doit.com/data/pricing.json
- **Cloud SQL**: https://gcpinstances.doit.com/data/cloudsql-pricing.json
- **Memorystore**: https://gcpinstances.doit.com/data/memorystore-pricing.json
- **AlloyDB**: https://gcpinstances.doit.com/data/alloydb-pricing.json
- **Exchange Rates**: https://gcpinstances.doit.com/data/exchange-rates.json

## Data Schema

Each pricing JSON file contains:
- `updatedAt`: ISO 8601 timestamp of last refresh
- `regions`: Array of GCP region identifiers (e.g. "us-central1", "europe-west1")
- `instances`: Array of instance objects with specs and per-region pricing

### Compute Engine Instance Fields
- `name`: Instance type (e.g. "n2-standard-4")
- `series`: Machine series (e.g. "N2")
- `family`: Category (e.g. "General Purpose", "Memory Optimized", "Compute Optimized")
- `vCpus`: Number of virtual CPUs (number or "shared")
- `memoryGb`: Memory in GiB
- `pricing`: Object keyed by region. Each region has:
  - `linuxOnDemand`, `linuxSud` (Sustained Use Discount), `linuxPreemptible`
  - `linuxCud1yr`, `linuxCud3yr` (Committed Use Discount)
  - `windowsOnDemand`, `windowsCud1yr`, `windowsCud3yr`
  - All values are hourly USD prices (floats)

### Cloud SQL Instance Fields
- `name`: Instance tier (e.g. "db-n1-standard-4")
- `vCpus`: Number of virtual CPUs
- `memoryGb`: Memory in GiB
- `pricing`: Object keyed by region. Each region has pricing per database engine:
  - `mysql`, `postgres`, `sqlserver_std`, `sqlserver_ent`, `sqlserver_exp`, `sqlserver_web`
  - Each engine has `onDemand` and optionally `cud1yr`, `cud3yr` (hourly USD)

### AlloyDB Instance Fields
- `name`: Instance type (e.g. "db-perf-optimized-N-2")
- `vCpus`: Number of virtual CPUs
- `memoryGb`: Memory in GiB
- `pricing`: Object keyed by region with `onDemand` hourly USD price

### Memorystore Instance Fields
- `name`: Node type
- `engine`: "redis" or "valkey"
- `memorySizeGb`: Cache capacity in GiB
- `pricing`: Object keyed by region with `onDemand` hourly USD price
